rubric_notes: Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. States SCOPe 2.08 lineage, superfamily SUNID 47113, all four curated families with SCCS, protein-level members, and the a.22.1.0 'not a true family' annotation, all supported by the bundle. Correctly characterizes cross-family relationships as superfamily-strength homology (more remote than family), notes fold/class alone would not assert homology, and explicitly declines to transfer octamer role, DNA packaging, TAF/NC2/NF-Y transcriptional role, partners, or template status without external evidence. Meets all must_include items and avoids both must_avoid items.

Correct full lineage for both domains, superfamily SUNID 101386, boundaries match bundle. Distinguishes superfamily-level probable common ancestry from fold resemblance and rejects bidirectional transfer of reaction, substrate preference, oligomeric state, pathway role. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct SCCS and SUNIDs for the three families, superfamily 53067/c.55.1, fold c.55, class c, plus the duplication comment, all verified in the bundle. Correctly characterizes the relationship as probable remote common ancestry stronger than fold similarity but weaker than family relatedness, and explicitly rejects transfer of chaperone/cytoskeletal roles, glucose or glycerol specificity, reaction chemistry, regulation, oligomeric state or whole-protein templates, listing the external evidence needed. Complete.

Complete. Correct identifiers for all three families, superfamily and fold; correctly quotes the fold core comment (4-helix closed bundle) and superfamily bimetal-centre comment, both in bundle. Accurately reports no homology warnings/heterogeneity for the four nodes and the PF05067 Pfam mapping on a.25.1.3 (all supported). Divergent-ancestry interpretation with explicit refusal to transfer family chemistries; lists residue-level structural alignment, catalytic-residue conservation, metal-bound structures, sequence/phylogenetic analysis, and biochemical assays as required evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete lineage with SUNIDs for class, fold, superfamily and all three families; explicit that shared superfamily supports probable common ancestry of the scaffold but not conserved copper site or redox chemistry; cites both family annotations lacking the metal-binding site; names conserved Cu-ligating residues, ligand-bound structure, and direct metal-binding/redox biochemistry as required external evidence. Fully supported. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

All SCCS and SUNIDs including fold 54235 verified. Correctly identifies family and superfamily as homology-bearing levels with d.15.1 as deepest shared node, contrasts with topology-only similarity, and notes the inspected records expose no functional evidence justifying cross-family transfer. Explicitly rejects transferring covalent conjugation, UBX/p97-adaptor behavior, and Ras/Rap binding, and distinguishes domain classification from whole-protein function. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Concise and complete: correct SCCS and SUNIDs for families, superfamily, and fold; supported by bundle. Supports probable common ancestry of the classified structural domains at superfamily depth rather than family equivalence; explicitly rejects transfer of CheY receiver phosphorylation/signaling, ODC PLP/substrate chemistry, and KaiA circadian-clock activity; cites the KaiA 'lacks canonical receiver-domain features' annotation; names evidence types needed. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22. Correct hierarchy with SUNIDs and all five b.84 superfamilies; example domains d3gqba3 (3gqb A:113-184, T. thermophilus HB8) and d1vdza2 (1vdz A:114-190, P. horikoshii) are verified in bundle. Correctly frames same-fold placement as topology only, homology positive within b.84.5/b.84.5.1, no superfamily-level ancestry assertion to b.84.1-b.84.4, and explicitly notes the split does not prove convergence or independent origin. Rejects function/context transfer. Bundle contains unrelated lookups (3aon, 3vr6, 1vpa) but these are not cited in the answer.

Correct 2.08 hierarchy including family-level children of each superfamily (f.21.1.1/1.2/1.0, f.21.2.1/2.2, f.21.3.1), all matching the bundle children responses; fold core comment and all three superfamily comments are supported. Clearly separates same-fold from same-superfamily, states homology is not implied above superfamily, treats the f.21.3 'possible link' as context rather than a merge, and lists independent evidence (sequence, structural alignment with heme-ligating residues, chain architecture, phylogeny, biochemistry). Calibrated; no absolute non-homology claim. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct identifiers for the three families and superfamily c.2.1/51735. Frames the relationship as remote homology of the Rossmann core with family-level functional divergence, explicitly rejects transferring ADH chemistry, CoA/succinyl-CoA synthetase role and K-channel regulation across families, uses the supported c.2.1.1 comment to caution against whole-protein architecture transfer, and lists the external evidence needed. Unrelated AlphaFold/search queries in the bundle are not cited in the answer. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete. Correctly places both domains in k.40.1.1 under the Amyloidogenic design-1 and Unnamed design-1 protein nodes, cites sunid 100905 and its 'not a true family' comment, explains why the normally homology-bearing family level is overridden here, and gives the calibrated safe interpretation. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Correct 1.69 and 2.08 classifications, SIDs, boundaries, and superfamily SUNID 52309. Correctly states 1.69 shared class only and that this absence was not proof of independent origin; 2.08 places both in c.23.14 with families c.23.14.2 vs c.23.14.1 as a probable-common-ancestry hypothesis. Rejects substrate/reaction/oligomer/template transfer, flags class-l tag artifacts with their warning, and cites the bundle-supported family annotation (lacks last strand, monomer, predicted deoxyribosyltransferase activity). Complete and well caveated.

Correct full lineages for both segments: d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 VH, d1a14h2 H:1-8 in class l Artifacts, l.1/l.1.1/l.1.1.1 Tags, N-terminal Tags, Synthetic. Cites homology_implied_by_level=false and artifact warning (supported for the domain record). Treats tag similarity as artifact similarity only, not homology, function, or template evidence. Complete. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct 1.75 lineage with SUNID, correct retrieved fold comment on internal regions, and correct boundary that the old SID is still returned for 2.03 while both new SIDs are present and the old one absent in 2.04, persisting in 2.08. Notes that SCOPe asserts no single superfamily relationship spanning residues 14 to 735, cautions that fold-level subdomain comments do not license treating every part as an independent search unit, and requires external evidence for function or template transfer.

Correct inventory, boundaries, SCCS, and lineage names; d.394 confirmed as Prp8-only fold via supported children call; mosaic interpretation; superfamily-level ancestry with explicit function-transfer limits and the extra caveat that 'new fold' is a classification statement, not proof of no remote relationship. Evaluator: Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct lineage and SUNIDs for all three domains; explains variable repeat count as the special repeat-family case; cites re heterogeneity, single-repeat comment, canonical representative 4cj9 A:259-292 with correct coordinate-transfer caveat; lists what cannot be copied between PthA, dHax3, BurrH.

Reports 2.08 / 2.08-stable and periodic 2.08-2026-08-16 with bundle support; advises citing 2.08 rather than an unqualified current endpoint, and citing the periodic label only when the analysis depends on that dated update or records present there (meets reproducibility criterion). Describes the periodic label as an incremental update attached to the stable series but does not explicitly state that it adds newly classified PDB entries without rewriting older stable-release domains. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy and SUNIDs, ms record and fragment comment verbatim, d1dn1b_ as automated match to the replacement d3c98b_ without the fragment caveat (1dn1 obsoleted by 3c98 is in the bundle). Explicitly says the fragments cover a local three-helix part that can resemble a spectrin repeat while the classified domain belongs to the STAT-like/t-SNARE hierarchy supported by the full Munc18/syntaxin structures; restricts fragment use to the covered core and names the external evidence needed for stronger claims. All criteria met. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct identifiers for c.2/51734, c.2.1/51735, c.3/51904, c.3.1/51905, supported by the bundle. States that NAD(P) binding can be conserved by divergence within c.2.1 but that its presence in c.3.1 is not inherited from a c.2.1 ancestor, that SCOPe makes no ancestry assertion across these nodes, and that a negative homology claim needs evidence outside the hierarchy. Explains why glycine-rich loops and hydride-transfer geometry recur, and requires full-domain alignment, ligand-bound structures, biochemical and phylogenetic data before transferring specificity, mechanism, or templates. Only two folds exemplified, but no errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Accurate before/after: d1nqda_ SUNID 86025 as b.23.2.1 under CUB-like b.23 in 2.04, moved to b.18.1.36 SUNID 267607 in 2.08, with d1dlca1 (A:500-644, SUNID 23719) unchanged at b.18.1.3; names b.18.1 SUNID 49785 as the deepest shared node. Supplies fold-level jelly-roll annotation and the PubMed 17977833 family note as structural support, keeps functional inference broad, and states clearly that ligand specificity, calcium complexation, template interchangeability, and residue-level equivalence are not transferable from the hierarchy alone. Eval: Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct lineage, SUNIDs 46690/125655/94286, quoted hf definition, domain-scoped non-inherited record, and comments, all matching the bundle. Homology within the Engrailed homeodomain lineage retained; structural interchangeability rejected; recommends excluding or stratifying d1ztra1 in benchmarks assuming ordinary fold; rejects blind template use and transfer of topology, contacts, alignments, DNA geometry, or mutant behavior without external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

All SUNIDs, species nodes, boundaries, fr annotation, and 'complexed with cr9' comment correct and supported. Family homology retained; align observed core with masked missing positions; fragment excluded or in explicit stratum, not sole template; correctly notes SPACI/resolution-based representative claims need quality records not retrieved; fragment understates FNIII extent and can exaggerate variation; rejects whole-protein function transfer. Complete answer. Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Complete. Correct choice, correct semantics for fold vs superfamily vs family, explicit statement that a new fold would wrongly reserve a separate topology when the core matches, list of non-transferable properties, required independent evidence types, and the asymmetry caveat that separate superfamilies do not prove non-homology. The d1u5ta1 bundle is not referenced in the text and introduces no errors. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

All three families with correct SCCS and SUNIDs under superfamily d.144.1/56112, fold d.144/56111, class d/53931, matching the bundle. Draws the superfamily-level common-ancestry conclusion and explicitly contrasts it with same-fold resemblance. Rejects each direction of unsafe transfer (aminoglycoside resistance, phosphoinositide specificity/membrane behavior, Ser/Thr/Tyr recognition and activation-loop regulation). Lists catalytic/substrate-contact residue conservation, ligand-bound structural comparison, biochemical and kinetic data, mutagenesis, domain context, and phylogenetic/profile evidence. Complete.
